title: Learning Graph Viewer
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Explain how a learning graph encodes prerequisite relationships as directed edges between concept nodes
Identify the ten taxonomy categories (Foundation, Types, Representations, Algorithms, Paths, Flow, Advanced, Metrics, Spectral, ML & Networks) by their legend colors
Use the taxonomy checkboxes to isolate a single category and interpret the resulting node, edge, and orphan counts
Distinguish an orphan node from a connected node and explain why orphans signal a learning graph that needs editing
Trace a prerequisite chain from a Foundation concept to an Advanced concept using the search box to locate each node
